qa_pairs.question: What torque should be applied to the M6 radiator mounting screw?
What is the torque specification for the drain plug on radiator (2AZ)?
How much torque should be applied to the temperature switch to radiator connection?
What temperature range is specified for the temperature switch to radiator?
Which radiator mounting fastener requires the highest torque?
qa_pairs.answer: The temperature switch to radiator requires the highest torque at 15 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which component has the lowest torque specification in the radiator mounting table?
qa_pairs.answer: The drain plug on radiator has the lowest torque specification at 2.5 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What vehicle types do all the radiator mounting specifications apply to?
qa_pairs.answer: All specifications apply to 'All' vehicle types

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection number covers radiator and mounting parts?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 17-2, subsection 17 11 covers radiator and mounting parts
